text_block_list.text:
I came to watch Mihono Bourbon's
dance lesson.
But, for whatever reason,
she's just staring at
herself in the mirror.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Processing information. All clear. No

irregularities have been detected.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Situational analysis based on personage,

location, and other factors. Examining all

possibilities...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Processing complete. Verdict—my face
is scary.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer. I didn't notice you there.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes, my face. I was walking through the
shopping
district earlier, and a baby
started to cry after our
eyes met.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Based on the circumstances, I have come
to the
conclusion that I have a "scary
face."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Is that true? I cannot identify any other

explanations.

It doesn't look like her feelings are hurt
from the
baby crying, but it does look
like it's weighing on
her mind.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I see... I failed to take into account the
other
party's disposition.
choice_data_list: Maybe they were in a bad mood.

text_block_list.text:
She looks at her face in the mirror again
and rubs
her cheeks.
A few days later...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I made the baby cry again.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I cannot tell babies' faces apart, but I
determined
that it was the same baby as
before based on the
parents' faces.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I identified the baby's emotional state as
being
one of "enjoyment" until it saw my
face.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I have determined that the cause of this
lies with
me.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Bourbon!
Oh, you're here with your
trainer too! Hello!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes. Hello, Nishino Flower.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Er... Did something happen? You both
look
concerned.

Nishino Flower seems worried, so I fill
her in.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Thus, the problem lies with me. That is
my
conclusion.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Hmm... I see.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um, Bourbon, what did you think when
you saw
the baby?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Its body was small and without power.
All
movements were limited. Overall, I
determined it
to be "weak."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Mhmm. So, you're saying you felt the
desire to
protect it!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Its body was soft and lacking durability,
and its
big, round eyes were staring
intently at me...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Uh-huh. So, you're saying the baby was
cute!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Yes. Put simply, that may be the
case.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Then maybe you should turn those
feelings into a
great big smile!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: A smile...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Babies are always looking closely at the
people
around them, and they change
their facial
expressions accordingly!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
A baby that lived in my neighborhood
was the
same way, so I'm sure that you
can get this baby
to smile too!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...I see. So in other words, they attempt
to copy
the expressions of others.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Understood.
choice_data_list: Next time, let's show them your smile!
Let's try making all kinds of faces!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Information updated based on new data.
Will
verify during next encounter.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much, both of you.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Hehe, good luck!
Some time later...

Mihono Bourbon runs up to me one day
while I'm
out and about in the shopping
district.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
No, I came here to execute operation
"don't
make the baby cry."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Here is my report.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Result—success. I was able to extract a
"smile"
from the baby.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed. The baby's smile was, well...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: It was... very cute.

She probably doesn't even realize it, but
Mihono
Bourbon is still smiling now as if
that baby was
right in front of her.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Now I understand. This warrants more

investigation into and analysis of
different
patterns of interaction.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Information updated based on new data.
Will
verify during next encounter.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Hehe, good luck.
Some days later...

While I'm out and about in the shopping
district, I
spot Mihono Bourbon
alongside a couple with a
baby.

Just as I'm about to call out to her, she
notices
me.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Perfect timing, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I came here to execute operation
"make
many faces."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I'm ready to report the results.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I was only able to produce the "smile"
expression
and could not carry out the
"anger" or "sadness"
expressions.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I do not know. When I smiled and
received one in return, I perceived a sort
of warm feeling inside of
my chest
region.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The creation of other facial expressions
became
difficult following this.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Cause unknown. Expression remained
stuck on smile. I believe some kind of
error may have
occurred in my facial
muscles or chest area.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Puzzling. Clarification required.

Mihono Bourbon is deep in thought with
a strange
look on her face. It's not really
something that
needs to be explained.

Reasons like "I just wanted the baby to
keep
smiling" or "I was drawn in by the
baby's smile"
are sufficient.

I decide to wait in anticipation for the
day that
she reaches an answer like that
for herself.
